versions.name: RXV2-0.9.594-dongle-no-fly
versions.notes: A dongle never shows the Fly now button: the 3-second repaint used to bring it back faded once the state arrived (Malcolm 2026-09-09). Radio-only morphing is skipped on a dongle too. Includes 0.9.593.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.593-dongle-face
versions.notes: A dongle looks like a dongle: the home page says 'Rotorflight dongle' and whether the flight controller is connected, and nothing that needs a transceiver is shown - no bind card, no transceiver warning, no Fly, Bind, Simulator or Black box; Setup hides the output protocol, channel view and receiver settings. Includes 0.9.592 (automatic dongle mode).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.592-auto-dongle
versions.notes: Dongle mode is now AUTOMATIC (Malcolm's idea): at every power-up the board counts its transceivers - none means it is a Rotorflight dongle, one or more means it is a receiver. A bare XIAO with this firmware is a dongle with no setting at all; the home page says why. The dongle page keeps an override (always a dongle / always a receiver) and the UART speed. Includes 0.9.591.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.591-dongle-wire
versions.notes: Dongle mode: the receiver's status now counts the bytes, frames and CRC errors on the flight-controller wire, so a silent flight controller can be told from a wiring or port-setting mistake. Otherwise as 0.9.590.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.590-dongle-mode
versions.notes: NEW: Rotorflight dongle mode (Setup page). A bare XIAO ESP32-S3 running this firmware, wired to a spare flight-controller UART set to MSP (D5 to its TX, D6 to its RX, 5 V, GND), gives the whole phone app - wizards, sliders, backups, Find a setting - on a model that any other receiver flies. It speaks plain MSP on the wire, outputs no channels, takes ARMED from the flight controller itself (configuration refused and radios off while armed), and leaves bank selections to the model's own switch. Includes 0.9.589 (re-centring sliders, PIDs search chip).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.589-slider-centres
versions.notes: Sliders that re-centre. Every plain-English slider (start hardness, agility, stick feel, cyclic and tail softer/sharper, on the Governor, Rates, PIDs and Easy tuning pages) now works relative to the numbers the model had at your last backup: the centre is 'what I have now', the ends are half and double (or 35 expo either way, or 30 % on the gains). Back up to the phone and every slider returns to its centre while the numbers stay exactly as they are - so a model that needed the far end of a slider can keep going. A restore or a bank copy re-centres too. The slider's note says when it is at the end of its travel. Each slider page says so when a slider has just been re-centred, so nobody wonders where it went. Find a setting offers PIDs as its first suggestion.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.586-search-spacing
versions.notes: Find a setting: menu entries no longer run their title into their subtitle ("Backup & restorethe whole setup"). Otherwise as 0.9.585.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.585-search-everywhere
versions.notes: Find a setting is now a magnifier button beside the ? on every page, so a search is one tap away wherever you are; the menu buttons for it are gone. Page titles sit below the button row on every page.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.584-search-tidy
versions.notes: Find a setting: a stray '_head' entry (an include file, not a page) removed from the index. Otherwise as 0.9.583.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.583-find-a-setting
versions.notes: NEW: Find a setting. A search box on the home page and the Rotorflight menu: type a word or two (head speed, cells, spool-up, arm, wiggle, bind...) and every matching setting is listed with the page and card it lives on. Tap one and the page opens with that setting glowing for a few seconds. The index is built from the pages themselves, so it always matches this receiver. Includes 0.9.580-0.9.582.
